reason: $59 a month is a lot when storytime and the parks are free, and daycare just went up on us. I would not sign up for a membership before I have seen the place and how my group likes it.
objection: I can already get most of this for free at the library and parks, so a monthly fee feels hard to justify, and a membership locks me in before I know we will actually use it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a group meetup rate for my moms group, so I can see it first. A drop-in around $8 to $10 with no membership would get me in the door.
